But the ultra-strong frequency of its signals has a devastating effect on the native Chubbits&hellip; crippling their nervous systems&hellip; in time, fatally!|An Imperial actor portraying Ben Kenobi provides an accurate assessment of the Empire's doings on Aridus|<ref name="Classic Star Wars 10">[[Classic Star Wars 10|''Classic Star Wars'' 10]]</ref>}}
The '''nervous system''' or '''electro-neural system''' was a component in the anatomy of certain biological [[Species/Legends|species]].

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] suggested the use of [[RX-200 Falchion-class assault tank/Legends|RX-200 Falchion-class assault tanks]] to short-circuit the the [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast's]] nervous system, in order to prepare it for transport to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Although Skywalker's plan was successful,<ref name="The Zillo Beast">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast}}</ref> the Beast broke free of its containment building and went on a [[Zillo Beast incident/Legends|rampage]] through Coruscant's cityscape, which only ended when [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces were able to kill it with [[Gas bomb/Legends|Gas bombs]].<ref name="The Zillo Beast Strikes Back">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast Strikes Back}}</ref>

For members of the [[Chubbit]] species of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aridus/Legends|Aridus]], the nervous system was vulnerable to deleterious effects effected by the [[Iron Tower]], a [[signal amplifier]], [[power transformer]], and power source used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to overcome [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] disturbances on the planet. When subjected to the Iron Tower's emissions, the Chubbit nervous system was crippled such that an individual might fall to the ground or even [[Death/Legends|die]].

The [[Ssi-ruu]]k's [[Ssi-ruuvi ion paddle beamer|ion paddle beamer]] worked by delivering an ion beam to a target's nervous system, paralyzing them for live capture.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
